## Summary

Describe the change and the user-visible or engineering outcome.

## Scope

- [ ] Acceptance criteria from the issue are met.

## Testing
- [ ] Automated tests added or updated.
- [ ] Relevant tests run locally.
- [ ] CI checks pass.

- [ ] Networking, permissions, privacy and security implications considered.

## AI review
